title: GC Agent Event
description: Canonical structured event document for a gc.agent.* governance lifecycle or operational event. Used for audit log storage, evidence bundles, and batch export. Mirrors the span attributes defined in docs/observability-contract.yaml v1.0.0.

gc_schema_version.description: Version of this event schema. Must be '1.0.0' for this schema version.

event_category.description: Lifecycle events use the canonical span names from observability-contract.yaml lifecycle_events. Operational events follow the gc.agent.<class>.<type> naming pattern.

span_name.description: Canonical OTel span name. For lifecycle events, MUST be one of the seven names defined in observability-contract.yaml lifecycle_events.

gc_agent_id.description: Stable kebab-case agent identifier matching the dossier identity.agent_id.

gc_agent_dossier_version.description: Semantic version of the agent dossier in use.

gc_event_type.description: Governance event type from agent-dossier telemetry_trace_schema. Security event types (anomaly_detected through chain_integrity_failure) added in PASS-4.

gc_trace_id.description: Governance trace ID. MAY equal the OTel trace_id when in a distributed trace context.

gc_event_id.description: Unique event identifier within the governance trace. MUST be stable — never re-used for a different event.

gc_time_loc.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp at the moment of emission. DDR-6 Layer 3 enforcement — REQUIRED. Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

gc_summary.description: Human-readable summary of the governance event.

gc_agent_parent_event_id.description: event_id of the parent event for causal chain reconstruction. Null if this is a root event.

gc_agent_evidence.description: Evidence strings supporting the governance event (file paths, URIs, commit SHAs, etc.).

gc_agent_task_id.description: Task identifier associated with the event. Required for scaffold and implementation lifecycle events.

gc_agent_pass_id.description: PASS-YYYY-NNNN identifier if the event is part of a recorded PASS.

gc_agent_handoff_envelope_id.description: Handoff envelope identifier. Required for handoff event types.

gc_chain_id.description: Stable identifier for the audit log chain this event belongs to. Format: gc-chain-<agent_id>-<YYYY-MM-DD>-<suffix>.

gc_chain_seq.description: Zero-based sequence position within the chain. The genesis event has gc_chain_seq = 0. MUST increase monotonically within a gc_chain_id.

gc_prev_event_hash.description: SHA-256 hash (lowercase hex, 64 chars) of the canonical JSON of the preceding event. Null or absent for genesis (gc_chain_seq = 0). Non-null for all subsequent chain events.

gc_agent_anomaly_category.description: Anomaly category. Required for gc.agent.anomaly.detected events.

gc_agent_policy_id.description: Policy or constraint identifier referenced by a policy violation event (e.g., 'AC-003'). Required for gc.agent.policy.violation events.

gc_agent_constraint_id.description: Authority constraint ID from governance/agent-constraints.yaml. Required for gc.agent.constraint.breach events.

gc_agent_auth_failure_reason.description: Root cause of an authentication failure. Required for gc.agent.auth.failure events.

gc_agent_chain_id.description: Chain ID of the chain where integrity failure was detected. Required for gc.agent.chain.integrity_failure events.

gc_agent_chain_seq_failed.description: The gc_chain_seq of the first event where hash verification failed. Required for gc.agent.chain.integrity_failure events.
